params.comment: Fake example data: replace each file under inputs/ and each allowance below with your own. One entry carries the params for all seven Credits metrics, because Git Crafter merges a targets file's params key by key (quality/overlay.mjs). A path starting with pack: is read from the pack's checkout, ~/ is home, any other relative path is from your repo's root, and a path from / is absolute. Every other key: targets/credits.json in the pack.
